transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we finalize the communications annex, I need to confirm a few things during our huddle. We have two portable relay kits available -- Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post require a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. I'll be assigning one kit to each site before the morning movement brief. Can anyone confirm the current equipment status on both kits, and are there any maintenance actions I need to be aware of before I sign the annex?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a requirement that hasn't made it into the annex yet. The northern liaison site must use Kit B -- it has the approved interoperability module installed that allows connection to the partner network. Kit A cannot connect to the partner network there. I received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but the requirement hasn't been added to the communications annex yet. This means Kit B needs to be assigned to the northern liaison site, and Kit A goes to the southern command post.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a maintenance issue with Kit B before you sign the annex. I verified the battery log this morning, but it hasn't been posted to the equipment status board yet. Kit B's installed battery pack is certified for exactly four hours, from 0800 through 1200. The replacement pack is staged at the commo shop, but it requires a 15-minute swap at 1200. That means Kit B will have a brief service interruption at noon when the battery is changed out. Given that Capt. Brooks just indicated Kit B must go to the northern liaison site for the partner network connection, we need to account for that 1200 maintenance window in the plan.
